protocol.outerSplit: Leave one entire session out; train on the other two.
protocol.innerSplit: Each training session held out in turn; select family/hyperparameters without outer labels.
protocol.selectionScore: Equal-session mean of both-fan MAE + 0.5 * worst-fan underprediction mean, in fan levels.
protocol.highFanDefinition: Actual CPU level >=39 or GPU level >=35; unsupported stratum is null.
protocol.causality: Feature snapshot log time <= fan acquisition; all five source epochs fresh at both snapshot and acquisition.
protocol.weighting: Equal total training weight per session; one target per distinct fresh fan acquisition.
protocol.labels: Raw fan pairs, including formerly unmapped levels. No A-D filter, no actual fan input, no load/power input.
protocol.limits: Three correlated sessions of one laptop; historic source epochs approximate acquisition. No proof of hidden OEM logic or control safety.

instantaneousThermalNeighborDiagnostic.interpretation: Similar current temperatures can coexist with different fan levels across sessions. This does not distinguish history, operating mode or other hidden inputs.

targetSupportDiagnostic.interpretation: Outcome support diagnostic only; never used to select, fit or predict.

originalSeed.definition: Midpoints of original ranges at the same causal feature snapshot; Unknown abstains.
